data_objects.name: sequence_site_differential_selection
data_objects.meaning: Site-level summaries of positive, negative, absolute, maximum, and minimum differential-selection scores for a biological sequence.
data_objects.notes: Site identifiers mix plain residue positions with parenthesized segment-prefixed positions.

variables.name: site
variables.meaning: Sequence-site identifier, encoded either as a numeric position or as a segment label followed by a position.

variables.name: abs_diffsel
variables.meaning: Aggregate absolute magnitude of differential selection at the site.

variables.name: positive_diffsel
variables.meaning: Aggregate positive differential-selection contribution at the site.

variables.name: negative_diffsel
variables.meaning: Aggregate negative differential-selection contribution at the site, stored with negative sign.

variables.name: max_diffsel
variables.meaning: Largest positive individual differential-selection contribution summarized for the site.

variables.name: min_diffsel
variables.meaning: Most negative individual differential-selection contribution summarized for the site.

structure.description: Each row represents one encoded sequence site; site serves as the row identifier.
positive_diffsel and negative_diffsel are signed aggregate components, abs_diffsel is their total absolute magnitude, and max_diffsel and min_diffsel are site-level component extrema.
Rows are ordered by descending abs_diffsel rather than by residue position.

uncertainties: The organism, sequence, comparison underlying differential selection, score normalization, and physical interpretation of the score scale are not supplied.
The exact grammar and coordinate system for segment-prefixed site labels are not defined.
annotation_notes: Only train.csv was used; long-form meanings are grounded in the joint diffsel field names and their signed encodings.
